actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent identity signal (BAP1 mutation enrichment, OR 25.2, q=0.0010), but cross-modal cohesion is weak (silhouettes near zero) and significant tissue-source-site imbalance (CJ enrichment, q=0.017) leaves a plausible technical competing explanation. No available evidence request remains, so this candidate is retained for downstream validation with these caveats.

C0002 shows the strongest coherent identity evidence (PBRM1 enrichment OR 9.18, q=0.00024, with concordant CNV features) and the best cross-modal support (median support 3, positive wsi/wxs/cnv silhouettes). However, multiple significant technical associations (BP site, GE manufacturer, LightSpeed16 scanner, STANDARD kernel) leave a plausible competing technical explanation, so it is retained for downstream validation with this caveat.

C0003 has coherent identity evidence (PBRM1 and VHL depletion, q<0.01) and no significant technical confounding. Its coherence is largely WXS-driven (wxs silhouette 0.613, other modalities near zero), so cross-modal consistency is limited, but no available evidence request remains and the candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0004 has only weak identity evidence (VHL enrichment nominal p=0.0084 but q=0.185, no CNV support) and its coherence is essentially WXS-driven with no all-modality-positive patients. No technical confounding is detected, and no available evidence request remains, so it is retained as a discovery-stage candidate with substantial uncertainty.
